description: Bicycle Rack locations is a dataset listed in Brisbane Open Data, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Brisbane City Council. Brisbane City Council list of bicycle rack locations in the Brisbane CBD. Includes suburb, address, location, capacity, rack type, latitude and longitude. Coverage: Brisbane, Queensland. The portal files it under Transport, Parking and Walking. Its keywords are active, bike, bikeway, healthy, location, transport. The portal shows 490 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-08-20 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-brisbane-qld-gov-au-portal.
